summary: Iter 92.50 GODMODE frontend validation — WladBot 3.0 live avatar + Fabulous-style onboarding. All 5 requested feature groups PASS end-to-end on Chromium 1920x900 as free@wladbot.test.

test_execution_evidence.avatar_png_load: /wladbot-avatar.png loaded on login-wladbot-trust (naturalWidth=512, img z-index=10 above Sparkles fallback) and 2x on /chat (both naturalWidth=512). Sparkle overlay bug NOT reproduced.
test_execution_evidence.login_trust_elements: login-wladbot-trust shows live avatar + wladbot-online-dot + 'WladBot 3.0' label + 'Online · zeigt dir jeden Tag die Richtung'. brandpanel-wladbot-trust bubble on desktop shows 'Ich bin auf Wlads komplette Methodik trainiert — und zeige dir jeden Tag die Richtung.' 'Willkommen zurück' heading present.
test_execution_evidence.wladguide_typewriter: wlad-guide + wlad-guide-text render on steps 2–7, typewriter effect animates. Step 2 msg: 'Felix, damit ich dich richtig coache…'. Step 3 msg after role=manager: 'Manager — ich kenne deine Baustellen. Woran arbeiten wir zuerst?' (correctly references chosen role).
test_execution_evidence.summary_chips: onboarding-summary-chips renders chosen role ('Manager') + goal ('Bessere Kommunikation') on step 8.
test_execution_evidence.regression_chat: /chat shows 2 WladBot avatars, both PNGs loaded (natW=512), no sparkle-overlay bug.
test_execution_evidence.regression_lock_modal: Free user clicking nav-locked-simulations opens locked-feature-modal (Iter 92.49 gating intact).

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: OnboardingPage.js is 456 lines with all 8 steps inline — future refactor could extract per-step components for readability (not blocking).
Minor: WladGuide typewriter uses interval clear on unmount but not on message change race; harmless because setTyped('') resets each message effect run.
Info: Screenshot after step 8 appeared washed/faded and Sparkles visually flashed briefly before img paint — but programmatic checks confirm PNG loads (naturalWidth=512) so no user-facing bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 92.50 fully green. Avatar PNG at /wladbot-avatar.png (512x512, 294KB) loads reliably on login, onboarding, and chat. WladGuide typewriter is role-aware. onboarding-summary-chips confirms chosen role+goal. If future tests need to re-run onboarding for the free user, note that navigating directly to /onboarding still re-renders the flow even if backend already flagged completion.
